question: Pritam Rani Siwach who received the prestigious 2021 Dronacharya Award contributed to the field of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**hockey.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pritam Rani Siwach** is a** former captain of the Indian women's hockey team.**
 
• She **received an Arjuna Award in 1998.**
 
• She** received Dronacharya Award 2021** from President Ram Nath Kovind.
 
• She last played with the team when it won the Gold at the 2002 Commonwealth Games.
 
• She is now **Coach with the Indian Women's Hockey team for World Cup and Commonwealth Games.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• The Dronacharya Award is given to coaches as recognition for their contribution to a particular sport.
 
• It is **officially called the Dronacharya Award for Outstanding Coaches in Sports and Games.**
 
• It is also** given to motivate coaches** to dedicate themselves to raising the performance of their athletes.
 
• It is **handed out on National Sports Day – celebrated on August 29.**
 
• The Dronacharya award is** named after the mythical character Drona** – who taught the art of warfare to the Kauravas and Pandavas.
